palette.primary_role: Deep navy/near-black for headings and dark sections (Stripe #061b31, Coinbase #0a0b0d, Revolut #191c1f). Pure white for light surfaces. The dark color is always a warm or blue-tinted near-black, never pure #000.
palette.accent_role: Blue-to-purple spectrum as the fintech trust color. Stripe's purple (#533afd) is warm and premium; Coinbase blue (#0052ff) is institutional; Revolut blue (#494fdf) is modern. Used for primary CTAs, links, and interactive highlights.
palette.surface_role: White primary canvas. Light gray (#f4f4f4, #eef0f3) for secondary surfaces and button backgrounds. Dark indigo (#1c1e54 Stripe) or charcoal (#282b31 Coinbase) for immersive brand sections alternating with white.
palette.neutral_role: Body text and secondary labels. Stripe uses slate (#64748d) for body. Coinbase uses muted blue-gray (#5b616e). Revolut uses mid-slate (#505a63). All are cool-toned neutrals that signal precision.
palette.border_role: Soft blue-tinted borders for cards and inputs. Subtle that reads clean and financial-grade, never heavy or decorative.

border_radius.sharp: 4px - 6px (Stripe conservative — financial precision reads in tight radii)
border_radius.typical_button: 4px (Stripe) to 9999px (Revolut) — fintech splits between conservative tight-radius and confident full-pill

button_styles.text: Start now, Get started, Sign up, Contact sales
Learn more, Talk to sales, View docs

elevation.shadows: ranges from flat zero-shadow (Revolut) to blue-tinted multi-layer (Stripe)
elevation.approach: Stripe uses brand-colored shadows (rgba(50,50,93,0.25)) for atmospheric depth. Revolut uses zero shadows — depth from color contrast only. Coinbase uses minimal shadow — depth from dark/light section alternation.

typical_order: header (sticky, white or transparent bg, logo left, nav links center/right, CTA button right)
hero (centered or split layout, massive headline + subtitle + primary CTA + secondary CTA + maybe product screenshot or abstract gradient)
trust_bar (customer logos or stats: 'Trusted by X companies', 'Y million users', G2 badges)
features (3-column grid, icon + title + description, often with product UI screenshots)
dark_feature_section (full-width dark navy/indigo bg + product screenshot + white text)
stats (counter animation: transactions processed, uptime, countries, etc.)
testimonials (quote cards with company logos, role-specific, often with headshots)
pricing (3-4 tier cards, monthly/yearly toggle, enterprise custom option, feature comparison)
cta (centered, gradient or dark bg, 'Start now' + 'No commitment')
footer (4-5 column: product, company, resources, legal, region selector + copyright)
hero_variants: weight_300_elegance (Stripe style — 56px sohne-var weight 300, -1.4px tracking, deep navy heading, gradient decoration)
billboard_scale (Revolut style — 136px Aeonik Pro weight 500, -2.72px tracking, massive declaration)
blue_trust_centered (Coinbase style — 80px CoinbaseDisplay, 1.00 line-height, centered on white, blue accent)
feature_card_variants: icon_top_3col (standard fintech pattern — icon + title + description)
dashboard_preview (product UI screenshot in card with blue-tinted shadow)
dark_section_card (white text on dark indigo bg, translucent borders)
numbered_step (large number + title + description for how-it-works)

tone_profile.headline_style: benefit-driven, confident but not hyperbolic, 4-8 words (e.g., 'Financial infrastructure for the internet', 'The future of money', 'One app, all things money')
tone_profile.cta_style: direct, commitment-light (Start now, Get started, Sign up free, Contact sales, See prices)
anti_patterns: stock photos of people shaking hands
too many competing CTAs above the fold

color_mood: purple_premium (Stripe: white bg, deep navy headings, #533afd accent, blue-tinted shadows — warmth through color choice)
blue_institutional (Coinbase: white + #0052ff, near-black dark sections, cool gray surfaces — trust through restraint)
dark_binary (Revolut: white + #191c1f, zero shadows, massive typography — confidence through simplicity)
typography_mood: weight_300_elegance (Stripe: sohne-var at featherweight 300, ss01 OpenType, negative tracking — whispered authority)
geometric_display (Revolut: Aeonik Pro weight 500, billboard scale, aggressive negative tracking — stadium fintech)
proprietary_trust (Coinbase: four-font system Display/Sans/Text/Icons — institutional completeness)
layout_density: precision (Stripe: measured, purposeful whitespace, dense financial data in generous chrome)
billboard (Revolut: huge headlines, generous spacing, pill buttons, zero decoration)
alternating (Coinbase: white sections alternating with dark sections, clean separation)

pricing_page.best_practices: 3-4 tier with monthly/yearly toggle, feature comparison table, enterprise custom option with 'Contact sales', transparent pricing with no hidden fees messaging

docs_page.best_practices: API reference with code examples in SourceCodePro, tabular data with tnum OpenType feature, interactive API explorer
